# Doubo (都播)

> {{ en.meta.description }}

Doubo is a native IPTV / M3U playlist player for iPhone, iPad, and Mac, built with SwiftUI and AVKit. It plays M3U / M3U8 playlists that users add themselves (by URL or file); it does not bundle or sell any channels. Highlights: grouped channel browsing, search and favorites, parallel channel checks, switching between multiple sources of the same channel, Picture in Picture, subtitle tracks, playback speed, DLNA casting to smart TVs, local video playback, and on-device storage with no ads or analytics SDKs. Apple TV and CarPlay versions are planned.
